The clinical picture of greasy yellow scales on the scalp and forehead in a 3-month-old infant is highly suggestive of infantile seborrheic dermatitis, often called cradle cap. I am requesting a biopsy to rule out other conditions like psoriasis or cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, though it is rarely needed for typical cases.
